messages:
Maya Rivera: That all-hands hit different today — roadmap looked so tight! Also low-stakes question: who wants tea and biscuits right now? 🍵🍪
Ben Cho: count me in for tea. big kudos to infra for the demo rollback to glory 🙌 :trophy:
Sofia Patel: shoutout to the infra elves 👏👏 honestly the uptime slide made me cry happy tears.
AJ: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheer-ovation-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI — instant mood boost :grin:
LighthouseBot: Poll created: "Quick snack poll" — options: Tea, Coffee, Pretzel, Donut. Vote with :one: - :four:. Poll closes in 15m.
Noah Kim: Donut for the win. (I may have bribed myself via lobby pastry stash) :doughnut:
Evelyn Park: who organizes the snack rota? i can volunteer 1 week if we get biscuits delivered.
Maya Rivera: @Evelyn Park you're a hero. also +1 to monthly ukulele cameo at the end of all-hands (purely for morale). :ukulele:
Ben Cho: can we get a tiny gong? like a ceremonial honor gong for big launches. low effort, high vibes. :gong:
Sofia Patel: also, can someone clip the CEO's one-liner about "latency as a love language" for posterity? that's a poster. :laughing:
AJ: saved that quote in #memes-forever. someone turn it into a sticker pack.
LighthouseBot: Poll results: Tea 42%, Coffee 33%, Pretzel 15%, Donut 10%. Tea wins! :tea:
Noah Kim: yay tea. I'll bring a box of Earl Grey to the 3pm demo room.
Evelyn Park: thanks everyone — mini bake-off next week? or is that chaos.
Maya Rivera: bake-off chaos = bonding. 100% in. :raised_hands:
